units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:1:1">Koh. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>צפור מְצַוֵּיץ ויורע על מה מצויץ</he> when a bird chirped, he (Solomon) knew what it chirped for; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:1:9">Cant. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>מְצַוְצֵי</he> (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 175:2">Yalk. Kings 175</cite> <he>מצפצף</he>).

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 6:1">Lev. R. s. 6</cite> (expl. <he>המצפצפים</he>, <cite ref="Isaiah 8:19">Is. VIII, 19</cite>) <he>המְצַוְּוצִין</he> or <he>המְצַיְּיצִין</he> (not <he>המציינין</he>); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 281">Yalk. Is. 281</cite> <he>דמצייצ׳</he> (read <cite ref="E00431"><he>המ׳</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 65">Gen. R. s. 65</cite> <he>אם מצאתם</he> … <he>מְצַיְּצִין בקולם וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. a. Var. Ar. <he>מצפצפין</he>) if you find there school children chirping with their voices, you cannot attack them (the Jews).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 65">Ib.</cite> <he>בזמן שקולו של יעקב מצוי וכ׳</he> (read: <he>מְצַוֵּיץ</he>; Ar. s. v. <he>מצוי</he>: <cite ref="M02287"><he>מצויין</he></cite>, cler. error for <he>מְצַוֵּיץ</he>; Var. <he>מצפצף</he>) when the voice of Jacob chirps in the synagogues, the hands are not Esau’s hands (they have no power over Jacob).

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 6:15">Tosef. Sabb. VI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 7:15">VII</cite>), 15 <he>המְצַיֶּצֶת לאורז</he> (not <he>לאוזן</he>, v. ed. Zuck. note), v. <cite ref="R00170"><he>צָוַוח</he></cite>.
